title: langchain-ai/langgraph: v1.0.0 release
summary: LangGraph 1.0 is here. A durable, low-level orchestration framework for building stateful, long-running agents. Adds durable execution, streaming, and human-in-the-loop primitives.

title: LangGraph 1.0 released for building stateful agents
summary: Discussion of LangGraph reaching 1.0, with commenters noting production use for agent orchestration and comparing it to alternatives.

title: NeuroForgeX 4.0 will replace all transformer training overnight
summary: An anonymous post claims a framework called NeuroForgeX 4.0 trains 500B-parameter models on a single laptop GPU in minutes and is about to make PyTorch obsolete. No official repository or paper is linked.

title: vllm-project/vllm: high-throughput LLM inference engine
summary: vLLM announces a new release with improved PagedAttention memory management and expanded model support for high-throughput, memory-efficient LLM serving.
